run_pca_compute: run the pca script to compute a PCA matrix from a numpy features file
run_pca_whitening: run the pca script with eigen power -0.5 to compute a whitened PCA matrix
run_pca_reduction: run the pca script to reduce feature dimensions and save the PCA matrix and bias
review_get_parser: review the get_parser function that defines argparse arguments for data, output, dim, and eigen-power
review_main: review the main function that loads numpy features, trains a FAISS PCA matrix, and saves results
